bullets: DESIGNED FOR G3 POT: This French press coffee filter is compatible with Fire-Maple G3 pot only, we don't recommed use with other models.
DURABLE CONSTRUCTION: Made of high-quality stainless steel, PP, silicone and nylon for lasting performance in outdoor conditions.
SMALL AND COMPACT SIZE: Folds to 3.7 x 3.7 x 5.4 inches and weighs only 1.5oz, this coffee filter is perfect for backpacking, hiking and more outdoor adventures.
EASY HANDLING: Comes with an heat-proof handle for safe and convenient operation while brewing coffee outdoors.
capture.description: Elevate your outdoor coffee experience with the Petrel French Press Coffee Filter-G3 from Fire-Maple. This durable aluminum camping accessory is designed for the adventurous coffee enthusiast who refuses to compromise on their brew quality while exploring the great outdoors. The standard-size filter comes with a practical handle for easy operation and features a sleek darkgray finish that complements your camping gear. Measuring 6.3 inches in height and 5.2 inches in width and length, this compact coffee filter is perfectly sized for your camping kit. Crafted with precision by Firemaple, this French press filter is built to withstand the rigors of outdoor use while delivering that perfect cup of pressed coffee. Whether you're setting up camp in the backcountry or enjoying a morning brew at your campsite, this coffee filter brings the comfort of home-brewed coffee to your outdoor adventures.
